text: acme-weather-api decision: Store historical telemetry aggregates in partitioned Parquet tables indexed by station_id and observation_month.
acme-weather-api code: AlertDispatcher evaluates severe wind-gust thresholds (>= 65 km/h) and publishes webhook events with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.
acme-weather-api bug: Duplicate webhook deliveries occurred during worker rebalance; resolved by recording idempotency keys per alert_id.
acme-weather-api note: Demo workspace configured for staging verification of severe weather webhook subscriptions and synthetic sensor feeds.
